name: Uga Kureha
source: A daughter in the Uga family. Kureha has been raised in seclusion in a remote part of the villa. She knows very little about the world and has barely ever spoken to anyone other than Yukina and Shigure. Due to these circumstances, she shows a strong interest in Hidetaka, an outsider, and wants to get close to him.
